summary: An external ledger_test spec opens a real PostgreSQL pool with pgxpool.New from an environment URL and stands up a real loopback webhook with httptest.NewServer: two real crossings in a test that is not a labelled acceptance suite. The fix keeps the spec external and drives only the exported API: the database substrate is pgmem, the webhook is a gomock MockINotifier generated from the exported INotifier, and the spec gains a misuse case (Record after Close returns the defined ErrClosed). Operator directive of 2026-10-01, verbatim in go-rules.md § CS-18.
